summary: BOI reports more than 2,000 game-industry workers in an article postedJanuary 2018, but references to last year alongside Gamescom 2016 make the actual observation year ambiguous. The 2022 target of 4,000 is a forecast. More recent creative-economy/digital-interactive totals include other industries and are not a clean games workforce.
